startGuards: isIniSearch or isSearching prevents duplicate start
confirmed.handshake: session_initialized; no own timeInSearch -> emit start_game_search; own timeInSearch -> restore searching state and elapsed time without another start
confirmed.recovery: POST /api/search/me with site-owned userId/authKey; connected === false invokes startSearch
confirmed.result: on_start_game_search.success is confirmation; game_search/in_game/ban/etc are separate errors
confirmed.handoff: on_game_found builds POST form for /game with CSRF, gameMode player, notify true, roleRequired, game_id, dynamicFilling; delay random 0-10000 ms

edgeCases: session_initialized may restore existing timeInSearch during preparation; then start_game_search is not emitted and adapter must handle existing queue explicitly
notProven: authenticated server queue priority is unchanged after disconnect/reconnect
exact server behavior when another connection with the same account is prepared while in a room

ssrMapping.censorshipDefaults: user && user.mmr && user.mmr.value !== 1000 ? [standard] : [polite]; valid nonempty localStorage.searchCensorshipModes array overrides, with modes restricted to standard/polite/prime

fields.roleRequired: e.roleRequired (no definition found in full panel props/data/computed or metric-only mixin; normal undefined becomes string undefined via setAttribute)
fields.csrf: field name from meta csrf-param; value from meta csrf-token
